title: Crazyflow: An Accurate, GPU-Accelerated, Differentiable Drone Simulator in JAX
abstract: arXiv:2606.01478v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: High-quality, large-scale synthetic data from simulations is becoming a cornerstone for pushing robots' capabilities. While aerial robotics simulators have evolved to support specialized needs such as fidelity, differentiability, and swarms independently, a unified platform that synthesizes data across all these domains is missing. In this work, we propose Crazyflow, a simulator designed to push the frontier of aerial robotics algorithm development, supporting model-based and data-driven methods, gradient-based and sampling-based approaches, single- and multi-agent systems, and state- and vision-based policy learning. Crazyflow combines high-fidelity dynamics with JAX for speed and differentiability, scaling to millions of environments or thousands of swarms with thousands of drones on single CPUs and GPUs, and beyond on clusters. translated_title: Crazyflow：一个基于JAX的精确、GPU加速、可微分无人机仿真器
translated_abstract: 来自仿真的高质量、大规模合成数据正日益成为提升机器人能力的基石。尽管航空机器人仿真器已分别发展到可支持保真度、可微分性和集群仿真等专门需求，但目前仍缺乏一个能够跨所有这些领域进行数据合成的统一平台。在这项工作中，我们提出了Crazyflow，一个旨在推动航空机器人算法开发前沿的仿真器，它同时支持基于模型和数据驱动的方法、基于梯度和基于采样的方法、单智能体和多智能体系统，以及基于状态和基于视觉的策略学习。Crazyflow将高保真动力学与JAX相结合，以实现高速度和可微分性，能够在单个CPU和GPU上扩展至数百万个环境或包含数千架无人机的数千个集群，在计算机集群上还能实现更大规模。真实世界实验表明，Crazyflow既支持基于解析梯度的策略学习……
tldr: 提出了Crazyflow，一个基于JAX的高精度、GPU加速、可微分无人机仿真器，统一支持高保真动力学、可微分性、单/多智能体以及状态/视觉策略学习，并可扩展至数百万并行环境和数千架无人机的集群仿真。
en_tdlr: Crazyflow is an accurate, GPU-accelerated, differentiable drone simulator built in JAX that unifies high-fidelity dynamics, differentiability, and massive-scale parallel simulation, supporting both single- and multi-agent as well as state- and vision-based policy learning at the scale of millions of environments and thousands of drones.
